import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Parse the included panda_fixed.xml (the main content)
panda_xml = """<mujoco model="panda">
  <default>
    <default class="panda">
      <joint armature="0.1" damping="1" axis="0 0 1" range="-2.8973 2.8973"/>
      <general dyntype="none" biastype="affine" ctrlrange="-2.8973 2.8973" forcerange="-87 87"/>
      <default class="finger">
        <joint axis="0 1 0" type="slide" range="0 0.04"/>
      </default>
    </default>
  </default>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="link0" childclass="panda">
      <body name="link1" pos="0 0 0.333">
        <joint name="joint1"/>
        <body name="link2" quat="1 -1 0 0">
          <joint name="joint2" range="-1.7628 1.7628"/>
          <body name="link3" pos="0 -0.316 0" quat="1 1 0 0">
            <joint name="joint3"/>
            <body name="link4" pos="0.0825 0 0" quat="1 1 0 0">
              <joint name="joint4" range="-3.0718 -0.0698"/>
              <body name="link5" pos="-0.0825 0.384 0" quat="1 -1 0 0">
                <joint name="joint5"/>
                <body name="link6" quat="1 1 0 0">
                  <joint name="joint6" range="-0.0175 3.7525"/>
                  <body name="link7" pos="0.088 0 0" quat="1 1 0 0">
                    <joint name="joint7"/>
                    <body name="hand" pos="0 0 0.107" quat="0.9238795 0 0 -0.3826834">
                      <site name="fixed_tcp" pos="0 0 .107" size=".003"/>
                      <body name="left_finger" pos="0 0 0.0584">
                        <joint name="finger_joint1" class="finger"/>
                      </body>
                      <body name="right_finger" pos="0 0 0.0584" quat="0 0 0 1">
                        <joint name="finger_joint2" class="finger"/>
                      </body>
                    </body>
                  </body>
                </body>
              </body>
            </body>
          </body>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <actuator>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator1" joint="joint1" gainprm="4500" biasprm="0 -4500 -450"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator2" joint="joint2" gainprm="4500" biasprm="0 -4500 -450" ctrlrange="-1.7628 1.7628"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator3" joint="joint3" gainprm="3500" biasprm="0 -3500 -350"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator4" joint="joint4" gainprm="3500" biasprm="0 -3500 -350" ctrlrange="-3.0718 -0.0698"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator5" joint="joint5" gainprm="2000" biasprm="0 -2000 -200" forcerange="-12 12"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator6" joint="joint6" gainprm="2000" biasprm="0 -2000 -200" forcerange="-12 12" ctrlrange="-0.0175 3.7525"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator7" joint="joint7" gainprm="2000" biasprm="0 -2000 -200" forcerange="-12 12"/>
    <general class="panda" name="actuator8" tendon="split" forcerange="-100 100" ctrlrange="0 255" gainprm="0.01568627451 0 0" biasprm="0 -100 -10"/>
  </actuator>
</mujoco>"""

root = ET.fromstring(panda_xml)

# Default values from <default class="panda">
default_joint_axis = [0, 0, 1]
default_joint_range = [-2.8973, 2.8973]
default_ctrlrange = [-2.8973, 2.8973]
finger_axis = [0, 1, 0]
finger_range = [0.0, 0.04]

# Collect joints
joints_info = []
for j in root.iter("joint"):
    name = j.get("name")
    if not name:
        continue
    cls = j.get("class", "")
    jtype = j.get("type", "hinge")  # default is hinge
    # axis
    if j.get("axis"):
        axis = [float(x) for x in j.get("axis").split()]
    elif cls == "finger":
        axis = finger_axis
        jtype = "slide"
    else:
        axis = default_joint_axis
    # range
    if j.get("range"):
        rng = [float(x) for x in j.get("range").split()]
    elif cls == "finger":
        rng = finger_range
    else:
        rng = default_joint_range
    joints_info.append({"name": name, "type": jtype, "axis": axis, "ctrlrange": rng})

print("Joints:")
for j in joints_info:
    print(j)

# Classification:
# - Single serial chain: link0 -> link1 -> ... -> link7 -> hand -> left_finger / right_finger
# - 7 revolute arm joints + 2 prismatic finger joints (coupled via tendon)
# - Fixed base (no free joint on root body)
# - Has a gripper (parallel jaw) at the end
# => "arm"

# DOF: 7 arm joints + 2 finger joints = 9 total joints
# But actuators: 7 arm actuators + 1 gripper tendon actuator = 8 actuators
# DOF for classification purposes = 7 (arm) + 2 (fingers) = 9

dof = len(joints_info)
print(f"Total joints (DOF): {dof}")
print(f"Arm joints: 7 (joint1-joint7)")
print(f"Finger joints: 2 (finger_joint1, finger_joint2) - coupled via equality constraint")
print(f"Actuators: {len(actuators_info)}")
print(f"Classification: arm")
print(f"EE site: fixed_tcp")
print(f"EE body: hand (parent of fingers, has the TCP site)")
